bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 12x12x12 inches are prohibited, and large bags must go through an x-ray scanner. Medical and parenting bags are allowed but subject to additional search.
prohibited: Bags larger than 12x12x12 inches without x-ray
bagPolicy.note: Medical and parenting bags exceeding size limits are permitted but subject to additional search procedures.

parking.note: Parking is available at various lots and garages around Amalie Arena, with card payments only. It's recommended to purchase parking in advance via ParkWhiz.com. The Pam Iorio Parking Garage is noted for ADA accessibility.

rideshare.note: Before the event, use the 15-minute drop-off circle just east of Morgan Street and Channelside Drive. Afterward, use a signed Rider Pick Up point at Jefferson and Eunice, Nebraska and Eunice, Nebraska and Cumberland, or Water and Cumberland.

concessions.note: Amalie Arena offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including Asian-inspired dishes, American classics, and Mexican cuisine. Highlights include bao buns, cheesesteak eggrolls, and a variety of craft beers. Special offerings include gluten-free and dairy-free options.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Buy accessible tickets on Ticketmaster using the accessible filter on the seat map. Free wheelchair escort service is available from staff, and assistive listening devices are at the Guest Services Desk across from Section 101 with a photo ID. Free sensory bags are at Guest Services, and there is a barrier-free entrance with an accessible elevator.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted. If you leave the arena for any reason, you will not be allowed back in.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Located on the west side of the arena, the ticket office accepts payment in the form of VISA, MasterCard, and American Express.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For Tampa Bay Lightning games, doors open 60 minutes before puck drop, and 90 minutes before for premium ticket holders. For other events, doors typically open 60 to 90 minutes before show time. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
